description: Publishes a harness and raw per-item results for author-run Jev comparisons on two small classification tasks.

notes: Author-run September 19 comparison using 200 items per task for accuracy/cost and separate 60-item sequential latency runs; raw per-item results, adapters and scoring-policy tests are committed. Banking77 and prompt-injection detection are both classification tasks, local supervised baselines had labeled training data, and hosted lanes used different routes. Prices, providers, network geography and model aliases can change. Harness, matching policy, result files, methodology and license were inspected at the pinned revision; no dataset, dependency, API call, benchmark lane or result reproduction ran here.
